stem: In November 2025 Voltmarkt sold 500 laptops for €400,000 net. 20 of those laptops came back, for €24,000 of refunds, net of VAT. Why is the returns rate by value higher than the rate by units?

options.text: The rate by units counts a laptop order as one unit, whatever its size
The laptops that came back were dearer on average than all laptops sold
The returned laptops were cheaper on average than all laptops sold
The value rate also counts refunds of laptops sold in earlier months
